name: bc-agentstudio
description: Builds and runs Boomi Agentstudio AI agents (the Agent Garden APIs) — list and inspect agents, author and update agent definitions, browse tools, sources, packages, deployments, and environments, and invoke deployed agents in a conversation; register custom AI agents in Agent Control Tower (ACT) and send their usage metrics. Use when the user works with Boomi Agentstudio / Agent Garden agents, agent tools, or agent deployments, or with Agent Control Tower, custom agent providers, or agent usage metrics.
